notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[b]Update Notes - Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]

[b]Boss Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the boss could leave the map unexpectedly during gameplay. The boss will now stay within the battle area as intended.
[b]General Bug Fixes: [/b]Addressed several other minor bugs and glitches to improve overall gameplay stability and performance.
[b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] Optimized various elements for a smoother gaming experience across all maps.

We’re always working to improve the game! Thank you for your feedback and support. Keep clucking on!

notes.title: "Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops" is Releasing on September 24th!
notes.content:
It’s time to gear up for Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops! On September 24th, our absurdly fun and chaotic action game will be officially released. Get ready to embark on a mission to destroy the evil Fried Chicken Empire (FCK) and free the chickens! Whether you’re blasting your way through hordes of enemies or laughing at the ridiculous scenarios, we promise non-stop entertainment.

Join us as we celebrate the release with a special in-game event and enjoy exclusive rewards. Plus, look forward to future updates, including multiplayer modes that will let you and your friends join the chicken revolution together!

Mark your calendars and prepare for chicken mayhem like you’ve never seen before!
